info.title: MyScoutee checkout-baskets
info.description: Typed calls to the existing CheckoutBaskets owner. Native validation, queries, state transitions and scheduler behavior retained. REAL/DEMO and explicit job scope; no-store. 2 MiB request / 8 MiB response bounds; no automatic retries. Existing event scheduler and fulfillment paths use their producer capability. Lost command replies must not overwrite an accepted basket with failed state; durable recovery remains milestone 16.
